quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year to March 2026 (annual securities report, IFRS): revenue JPY 35,827 hundred million (+4.7%), with every segment growing; operating profit JPY 3,599 hundred million (up JPY 1,034 hundred million); adjusted operating profit JPY 3,868 hundred million; Non-GAAP operating profit JPY 3,972 hundred million (up 859); profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 2,702 hundred million (up 950). IT Services revenue JPY 25,089 hundred million (+2.0%, adjusted operating profit 3,367) on strong domestic public-sector demand and BluStellar; Social Infrastructure revenue JPY 9,353 hundred million (+12.4%, adjusted operating profit 743) on aerospace and national security. No external customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: FY to March 2026 revenue JPY 35,827 hundred million (+4.7%); Non-GAAP operating profit JPY 3,972 hundred million

quarterly_data.signal: '2030 Mid-term Management Plan' (May 2026) targets for fiscal 2030: Non-GAAP operating margin of 15% or more, Non-GAAP operating profit doubled from fiscal 2025, and Non-GAAP EPS growth averaging 15% or more a year (fiscal 2026-2030). Strategy: in IT services, a shift to consulting plus continuous operations around IT, data and AI (BluStellar), and integration of CSG Systems International with Netcracker to strengthen telecom / broadband software in North America; in social infrastructure, aerospace and defense, submarine cable systems (400,000 km laid over 60 years; it aims to raise market share) and cybersecurity. The conventional base-station business is being wound down to focus on vRAN.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2030 targets: Non-GAAP operating margin 15%+, Non-GAAP operating profit 2x FY2025, Non-GAAP EPS CAGR 15%+

quarterly_data.signal: NEC acquired CSG Systems International, Inc. (US telecom / broadband software) through NEC Corporation of America under a merger agreement approved by its board on October 29, 2025; the acquisition completed on May 14, 2026 and CSG became a consolidated subsidiary. On April 1, 2026 the telecom-operator software and services business moved from the Social Infrastructure to the IT Services segment.

Capex and R&D (annual securities report): capex (excluding right-of-use assets) JPY 61,411 million in FY2026 (IT Services 22,506 million for cloud-service facilities, Social Infrastructure 13,697 million for defense and satellite systems and submarine-cable production); planned capex for the next year JPY 75,000 million (IT Services 30,000 million cloud facilities, Social Infrastructure 20,000 million defense and satellite systems, other 25,000 million). R&D spending JPY 105,239 million. AI products: the 'cotomi Act' business-automation AI agent, which NEC says was the world's first to exceed human task success on the WebArena benchmark (80.4% vs 78.2%), offered as a solution since January 2026; a procurement-negotiation AI agent service since December 2025; AI agents built on its generative AI 'cotomi' for security-risk diagnosis and internal-audit support under the 'CyIOC' brand.
quarterly_data.figure: capex plan JPY 75,000 million; R&D JPY 105,239 million; cotomi Act 80.4% on WebArena
